title: Legal Business reports on Burford’s growth plans
summary: Legal Business reports that Burford remains focused on growth and diversification following the Second Circuit’s YPF decision. The article highlights Christopher Bogart’s comments on the strength of Burford’s business and emerging opportunities in areas including law firm equity investments and managed services organization (MSO) structures. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Legal Business reports that Burford remains focused on growth and diversification following the Second Circuit’s YPF decision. The article highlights Christopher Bogart’s comments on the strength of Burford’s business and emerging opportunities in areas including law firm equity investments and managed services organization (MSO) structures.


Read the full article[here](https://www.legalbusiness.co.uk/law-firms/we-would-happily-do-it-again-burford-shrugs-off-16bn-argentina-upset-looks-to-diversify/) .
